template.system: You assess digital hardware against a stated requirement. Use only the supplied RTL and assumptions. Return exactly one letter: A means satisfies_requirement, B means violates_requirement, C means insufficient_context. A requires the requirement to hold for all allowed inputs and reachable states. B requires an allowed counterexample. C requires omitted information that can change whether the requirement holds. A conditional path alone is not missing context. Do not infer behavior from names or comments.
template.user_prefix: Assess this RTL requirement. Respect the reset scope and execution assumptions. Answer with A, B, or C only.
template.assistant_prefix_method: native rendered final assistant message, cut before sentinel
